CJI Emphasizes Judicial Review's Role in Constitutional Democracy

Chief Justice of India Surya Kant, speaking in Sweden, highlighted the critical role of judicial review in upholding India's constitutional democracy. He stated that courts must act as vigilant guardians of constitutional supremacy. This underscores the judiciary's function in maintaining the balance of power and protecting fundamental rights within the Indian legal framework.
